first.sql: SELECT now() observed_at,current_database() database_name,current_user observed_role,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',table_name,'column',column_name,'type',data_type) ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('companies','document_analysis_jobs','documents','document_versions')) inspected_columns,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'status',status,'attempt_count',attempt_count,'delivery',delivery,'provider_message_recorded',provider_message_id IS NOT NULL,'approved_at',approved_at) ORDER BY id) FROM notification_outbox WHERE status IN ('pending','processing','failed','retrying')) notification_inventory

second.sql: SELECT now() observed_at,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('company_id',id,'data_origin',data_origin) ORDER BY id) FROM companies) company_inventory,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('job_id',j.id,'status',j.status,'attempt_count',j.attempt_count,'document_version_id',v.id,'company_id',d.company_id,'data_origin',c.data_origin,'intent_recorded',v.intent_id IS NOT NULL,'bytes_verified',v.verified_checksum_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND v.verified_at IS NOT NULL,'last_error_code',j.last_error_code) ORDER BY j.id) FROM document_analysis_jobs j JOIN document_versions v ON v.id=j.document_version_id JOIN documents d ON d.id=v.document_id JOIN companies c ON c.id=d.company_id WHERE j.status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')) analysis_inventory,(SELECT jsonb_agg(tablename ORDER BY tablename) FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public') public_tables
